analysis.title: Global Economics Daily Points, November 12, 2026
key_insights: Nasdaq futures are down nearly 1% as markets await the fate of Nvidia's Jensen Huang, with evidence of spying raising possible implications for Trump's visit to China next week.
Markets price a few basis points over a quarter-point Fed hike on December 9th. Only Governor Waller appears to support a 50bp hike, so upsizing has little support.
Short-term US Treasury yields are about 3bps higher as Fed-speak is digested. Canadian pricing for the December BoC move is on the fence at 13bps, partly through spillover from the US.
Trump threatened on social media to double unspecified tariffs on Mexico if it does not curtail caravans. The Mexican peso slid.

Tuesday's Fed speakers were mostly hawkish but mostly consistent with +25bps in December. Waller is likely to advocate 50bps, Logan backs at least 50bps of further tightening without addressing upsizing, Bowman says drivers of inflation should abate in 2027, Paulson prefers gradual hikes, Schmid calls policy fairly accommodative, and Goolsbee kept all options open.
Six more Fed speakers are scheduled today: Hammack, Barr, Goolsbee, Daly, Schmid and Williams. The tone is expected to resemble Tuesday's.
UK Q3 GDP rose 0.7% q/q SA, in line with consensus. Consumer spending (0.6%), exports (1.6%) and investment (1.7%) drove growth, and surging imports (1.8%) were a drag.

UK GDP rose 0.2% m/m in September against 0% consensus, with August revised down to 0% from 0.1%. Industrial output rose 0.3%, services 0.2% and construction 0.8%, while the trade deficit widened. Sterling and gilts largely ignored the data as stale.
Light US data today: jobless claims, October existing home sales and the October federal budget balance.

tension_points.bull_case: Most speakers used language consistent with +25bps, and market pricing is a few bps over 25bps.
tension_points.bear_case: Waller is likely to advocate 50bps and Logan backs at least 50bps of tightening, possibly more rapidly this winter.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Hawkish upsizing language from today's speakers (Hammack, Barr, Goolsbee, Daly, Schmid, Williams) would challenge the 25bp base case.
